title: Microsoft 365 admin center: unified Google Workspace migration for Gmail and Google Drive
summary: The briefing passes: the migration routes, role-assignment path and Graph call are supported by Microsoft documentation. It accurately reports the outdated roadmap target, the conflicting size boundary and the simplified flow's availability caveat, without promising a rollout date or a free migration tool.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans a unified Microsoft 365 admin center page for starting Gmail and Google Drive migration.
claims.quote: Through a unified portal page, you can initiate and monitor migration tasks for both Gmail and Google Drive.

claims.claim: The unified page supports monitoring the migration tasks.
claims.quote: Through a unified portal page, you can initiate and monitor migration tasks for both Gmail and Google Drive.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes a revamped step-by-step Gmail flow for Google Workspace tenants with fewer than 1,000 users.
claims.quote: if your Google Workspace tenant has fewer than 1,000 users, you'll benefit from the newly revamped Gmail migration flow, which simplifies the process and guides you through each step.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Assign the migration role in Microsoft Entra admin center through Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to Identity > Roles & admins. Select a role name to open the role. Don't add a check mark next to the role. Select Add assignments

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments creates the role assignment, using roleDefinitionId, principalId and directoryScopeId in the body.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments
{
    "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.unifiedRoleAssignment",
    "principalId": "<Object ID of user or group>",
    "roleDefinitionId": "<ID of role definition>",
    "directoryScopeId": "/"
}

claims.claim: A directoryScopeId of / assigns the role at tenant scope.
claims.quote:
Assign roles with tenant scope
This section describes how to assign roles at tenant scope.
Set tenant as scope of role assignment.
$directoryScope = '/'

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator role governs Migration Manager for Google Drive, rather than documenting entitlement to the Gmail flow.
claims.quote:
Access Migration Manager to migrate from file shares, Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, and Egnyte.
This role only allows access to Migration Manager.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant UI or API switch to hide or disable the unified Google Workspace migration page as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Google Workspace migration disable admin center Graph switch; Google Workspace migration hide switch Graph. Read consolidated-gws-migration, custom-migration-small-business-from-gmail, mm-google-overview and returned migration excerpts; none documents such a switch.

claims.quote: After domains are added in FRE or when the TA returns later for a returning user experince (RUE), the TA sees tiles specific to workloads. The TA sees a Mail tile

claims.claim: The dashboard also displays a Drive tile.
claims.quote: Similarly, TA also sees a Drive tile listing metadata about the source Google drive.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Above 1000 source users or mailboxes, Microsoft directs administrators to the large-tenant classic Gmail migration route.
claims.quote: If your total mailbox count is >1000, you're guided to the CGM flow.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Where available, the simplified flow is for a source mailbox count of 1000 or fewer.
claims.quote: If the total mailbox count is <=1000, you're guided to the SGM flow.

claims.claim: The Drive route uses Migration Manager to copy Google Drive content into OneDrive and SharePoint.
claims.quote: Bring your content together by migrating Google Workspace files, metadata, and permissions to OneDrive and SharePoint in Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: The simplified flow begins with signing in to Google using migration administrator credentials.
claims.quote: Log in to Google using migration admin credentials.

claims.claim: The simplified flow requires installation of the Google Marketplace app Microsoft 365 Mail Migration.
claims.quote: Install a Google marketplace app custom built for GWS mail migrations, called "Microsoft 365 Mail Migration".

claims.claim: The administrator confirms Google credentials again after the app setup.
claims.quote: You need to confirm your Google credentials again to make sure access and permissions are in order.

claims.claim: The administrator chooses which mailboxes to migrate.
claims.quote: At this point, you can choose mailboxes (one, many, or all) to migrate from GWS to EXO.

claims.claim: The simplified workflows offer selection of mail, calendar, contacts, rules, permissions and delegates.
claims.quote: type of data (mail, calendar, contacts, rules, permissions, delegates).

claims.claim: The simplified workflows offer selection of all data or a date range.
claims.quote: duration of data (all or from a date range).

claims.claim: After all mailboxes finish migrating, the administrator chooses Complete Migration.
claims.quote: Once the migration of all mailboxes is done, mark the completion of migration by choosing the option Complete Migration in the experience. This option is available to you only when the migration of all mailboxes is done.

claims.quote: Now you see two different workflows – one to migrate regular sized mailboxes, and other to migrate large mailboxes (>80 GB).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Installing the mail migration app grants Google API access to directory information.

By installing the app, you're granting the following permissions via the respective APIs:

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The app grants permissions for migrating Gmail, calendar, contacts and tasks.
claims.quote: With the permissions mentioned in this article being granted, the service account will sync the user's data of your selection from GWS to EXO. In this experience, you choose the data (Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Tasks, Rules, Permissions, and Delegates)

claims.claim: The app does not modify source Google mail, calendar, contacts or tasks.
claims.quote: The app does not modify or delete your data from GWS mail, calendar, contacts, or tasks.

claims.claim: The app does not delete source Google mail, calendar, contacts or tasks.
claims.quote: The app does not modify or delete your data from GWS mail, calendar, contacts, or tasks.

claims.claim: Migration Manager never deletes source data.
claims.quote: Migration Manager never deletes source data. It copies data from the source to the destination, similar to copy and paste rather than cut and paste.

claims.claim: Drive file-level permission migration is off by default.
claims.quote: File-level permission migration is off by default; files otherwise inherit destination folder permissions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Migration Manager does not recreate external sharing links, and Microsoft advises recreating them manually after migration.
claims.quote: Migration Manager doesn't recreate external sharing links. Recreate the links manually in the destination after migration.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Installing the Google Marketplace migration app requires Google administrator privileges.
claims.quote: To install this app in your Google Admin console, you need administrator privileges.

claims.claim: The large-tenant batch route requires a Google Workspace super administrator to authorize domain-wide delegation.
claims.quote: Domain-wide delegation is a separate Google Workspace authorization. A Google Workspace super administrator must authorize the API client and OAuth scopes.

claims.claim: Migration Manager accepts OneDrive/SharePoint admin, Global admin or Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator on the destination tenant.
claims.quote:
You must be one of the following roles in the Microsoft 365 tenant where you want to migrate your content:
OneDrive/SharePoint admin
A user granted the Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator role
Global admin

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator is the narrower migration-focused role compared with SharePoint admin and Global admin.
claims.quote:
With this new role, you limit usage to only what is required to migrate your content, reserving SharePoint Admin access to only users who need it.
This role only allows access to Migration Manager.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on 2024-11-22T23:15:35.
